@peterdaou As a gay woman of color who can say #MeToo, I have been in the midst of triggering PTSD since 3 am, November 9th, 2016. That’s the exact date/time I realized that @HillaryClinton would not be sworn in. My sleep & my body suffer. 

I am angry, depressed, & determined to persevere.

@BetteMidler @MelissaJPeltier My physical health has suffered. My emotional health has suffered. As a gay woman of color, first & multigenerational American, & #MeToo, Donald Trump assaults every fiber of my being. I haven’t slept through the night since 11/09/2016, the moment I realized Trump had prevailed.
